text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Gwaaah! So frustrating! And here I thought I had it in the bag!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Beating big sis Hishi Ama is no small feat!
That was a great match!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, running against tough opponents is the best!
My tail is still tingling with excitement...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, coming up short is frustrating, but
this is the result of a fair and square match—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd get there, but my finish was lacking...
Dammit, if that's how it is—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to do but move my body all out!
I'll blow away these running blues with more running!!!
choice_data_list: But you just finished a race!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's just 'cause the race is over! I'm runnin' all the way home! Whoaaaaaa!!!!

Though I hurriedly chased after her,
there was no way I could catch up to
a sprinting Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Of course! No matter how strong the opponent is, Hishi Ama-neesan never gives up!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, everything except eating and sleeping is practice!
No, actually, I'll just skip sleep and practice even more!!"
choice_data_list: You gotta get some proper sleep!
You really have to get some proper sleep!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Zip it!
That just shows how determined I am!
I'll train up with pure fighting spirit and take total victory next time!!!
